text:
ana: quick heads-up — qbringup int4 smoke (canary run) showed ~12% hallucination on deid prompts, esp long-context. i pulled the failing ids. tagging @matt @sophia for curation/labeling next steps

matt: which run id? link?

sophia: the run is quant-smoke/2026-03-15 (looks like the new kernel picks). saw repeated email-like tokens in outputs :eyes:

luis: quick provenance check gave this:```sql
-- find samples that hit canary and are not marked deid
SELECT id, fingerprint, provenance ->> 'source' as src
FROM samples
WHERE id IN (SELECT sample_id FROM canary_hits WHERE run='quant-smoke-2026-03-15')
  AND deid_flag = false;
```
Result: 74 rows.

ana: ok — we need a small sleuth + golden update: remove ~40 obvious bad ones, replace with 40 reprompted/cleaned variants. who can take the golden relabel?

tara: i can do the golden 40 and do a quick edge-case pass on another 160. ETA ~6h.

label-bot: Assigned 40 samples to @tara (job: gold_relabel/1765439012). Please mark done with `/label done <job>` when finished.

matt: i'll run a fuzzy dedupe pass before replacement; plan: `python infra/tools/dedupe.py --thresh 0.82 --scope=canary --output=dedupe-1765439012.csv` should finish ~20m. will preserve fingerprint and provenance metadata.

sophia: after dedupe+relabel, i'll regenerate the promptset diff and rerun the quant-smoke with int4+kv-cache disabled for the canary bucket. seed=42. i'll also add a short-context penalty to see sensitivity.

ana: timeline: dedupe today, golden relabel by EOD tomorrow, quant smoke by Friday morning. are we good?

luis: pushing the 74 sample list to the labeling queue now: `/label assign --team=ml-curation --ids=$(cat dedupe-1765439012.csv)` — will also attach provenance blob to each id.

tara: ack, pulling list. quick note: found 3 borderline PII where deid_flag was False but source text includes tokenized SSN-like pattern. flagged as `needs-privacy-review`.

sophia: please escalate those 3 to privacy. if privacy verifies, we either scrub or drop. also keep a mapping of removed->replacement ids in the golden changelog so we can trace regressions.

matt: small ops FYI: dedupe script will annotate `dupe_group` column. do not use that column to decide gold removal without manual review (false positives at 0.82).

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled node pool maintenance tonight 23:00 UTC — does not affect isolated canary cluster.

ana: also: don't forget to run the fingerprint regen on replacements with tokenizer v2 to avoid accidental collisions: `tools/tokenhash regen --tokenizer=v2 --ids repl_ids.txt`

luis: note added. i'll also snapshot the canary metrics before replacements so we have baseline.

tara: halfway through the 40, 7 marked `borderline` -> escalated. continuing.

sophia: thanks — once tara finishes, i'll attach the new golden set to the eval harness and kick off the smoke with the quant configs. will share logs in this thread.

matt: one more: keep `metadata.provenance` intact in the new rows (copy old provenance + note `replaced_for_regression`). helps A/B rollback.

ana: perfect. ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

tara: done for the 40 golds, pushed `gold_relabel/1765439012.done` and added comments on the 7 escalations.

sophia: starting the quant-smoke job now (job id qs-1765439075). i'll post summary in ~30m.

ana: cheers everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.
__comments: This thread is a short curation and bring-up coordination discussion for deid-sensitive samples during a quantized model canary. Messages are short and Slack-style.
